stories.title: Solheim Cup Day 1 — USA Leads Foursomes 2-1 at Bernardus Golf

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
USA leads Europe 2-1 in Solheim Cup foursomes at Bernardus Golf.

Korda and Corpuz beat Hull and Woad to go 5-0 in foursomes together — a new Solheim Cup pairing record.

One match still finishing. Afternoon fourballs are next.

#SolheimCup #LPGA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
USA takes 2-1 foursomes lead into Friday afternoon fourballs at the Solheim Cup.

Nelly Korda tees off again this afternoon at Bernardus Golf.

4 more points available. Europe needs to respond.

#SolheimCup #LPGA

article.headline: USA Leads 2-1 After Solheim Cup Morning Foursomes — Korda and Corpuz Set Pairing Record at Bernardus Golf

stories.title: LIV Golf Bankruptcy Day 3 — Initial Financing Approved

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf's initial bankruptcy financing just cleared court.

Judge Kaplan approved the $49.6M DIP financing from PIF and granted complex-case designation.

The case is moving. BC Partners' LIV 2.0 restructuring plan is now the formal path forward.

#LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf's timeline to resurface is becoming clearer.

DIP financing approved. BC Partners exit plan confirmed. 10-event 2027 circuit on deck.

All 48 player contracts still terminated. Rahm and DeChambeau are watching from the outside.

#LIVGolf #Golf

article.headline: LIV Golf Bankruptcy Day 3: Court Approves Initial Financing — BC Partners' LIV 2.0 Plan Now the Formal Path Forward

stories.title: Biltmore Championship — 6 Days Out, First PGA Tour Event in Western NC in 80 Years

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Six days until the Biltmore Championship in Asheville.

100+ players. A Jack Nicklaus design. The first PGA Tour event in western North Carolina in over 80 years.

The Cliffs at Walnut Cove, Sept 17-20.

#PGATour #BiltmoreChampionship

article.headline: Six Days to Biltmore Championship — Asheville Gets Its First PGA Tour Event in More Than 80 Years

stories.title: Rahm and DeChambeau — Day 3 of Free Agency After LIV Collapse

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Three days since LIV Golf filed bankruptcy and terminated all 48 player contracts.

The PGA Tour says there is "no current path back" for Rahm and DeChambeau.

LIV 2.0 in 2027 is the only real option on paper right now.

#Golf #LIVGolf
